info.name: Parent Application Management
info.description:
We are making updates to our collections. If you run into any issues pulling the latest changes, simply fork the collection again.

LinkedIn's Provisioning APIs allow partners to create and configure developer applications on behalf of their customers. This is an initial step to manage and enable customer integrations. Refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/middleware-platform/provisioning-api) for more information.  
Ensure that you select Partner Application Management environment while executing use cases.

item.name: Use Cases
Provision Customer (Child) Applications

request.description: Use this API Endpoint when partner wants to create a child application for any of mutual customer. Refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/middleware-platform/provisioning-api#create-application) for more information.

item.name: Update JavaScript SDK Domain for Child Application

request.description: Use this API Endpoint when partner wants to update JavaScript SDK domain for child application for any of mutual customer. Refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/middleware-platform/provisioning-api#update-application) for more information.

item.name: Update OAuth2.0 Authorized CallBack URL for Child Application

request.description: Use this API Endpoint when partner wants to update OAuth2.0 Authorized CallBack URL for child application for any of mutual customer. Refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/middleware-platform/provisioning-api#update-application) for more information.
